shared_elements: circular/disc motif (concentric circle on A; rosettes on B)
suggestion of a human figure (A's anthropomorphic torso and head; B's standing attendant in profile)
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief carving that includes a human-derived form and round disc-like motifs (a concentric circle on A, a border of rosettes on B), but that is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A is a frontal, blocky anthropomorphic monolith with abstract symbols spread over a body, while B is a narrative profile scene of a two-humped pack animal led by a striding attendant between framing ornamental bands — different subjects, viewpoints and compositional logic.
